title: Geomagnetic anomalies at UFO hotspots

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that places famous for strange sightings, like Skinwalker Ranch, a property known for reports of odd events, or Mount Sangun Mori in Japan near the Fukushima area and its civilian nuclear power network, always seem to have geomagnetic anomalies, meaning spots where the Earth's magnetic field behaves oddly. If true, it would hint that whatever is seen at these places is drawn to, or tied to, those magnetic quirks.
